dict.string: SubScreen Studio reads the current song from Apple Music and YouTube Music browser tabs for the Now Playing widget.
SubScreen Studio detects when your AirPods connect so it can show the connection animation on your sub-screen.
SubScreen Studio shows your next event in the Calendar widget.
SubScreen Studio shows your incomplete tasks in the Reminders widget.
SubScreen Studio uses microphone levels to animate the live audio visualizer. Audio is processed on this Mac and is not recorded.
SubScreen Studio uses your current area to show local weather in the Environment widget.
SubScreen Studio captures only the window you choose for the Window Capture widget.
